newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian driver's bid to save pig costs 16 lives.
newsitem.headline: Colombian driver's bid to save pig costs 16 lives.

text.p: A bus driver's efforts to avoid hitting a pig cost the lives of 16 people killed in a road accident in northern Colombia, police said on Tuesday.
They quoted survivors as saying the driver swerved to avoid a pig crossing the two-lane highway and his bus ploughed into a dump truck bearing down from the opposite direction.
Many victims of Monday's crash in northern Sucre province were schoolchildren returning home from an excursion, police spokesmen said.
